How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

•
AI Agent

To get the best result with your air up® bottle, here’s what to do:

Fill your bottle with cold water (10–12°C is ideal) for maximum scent magic! ❄️
Pop your pod onto the mouthpiece with the pointed end facing down, and activate it (pull up for PullUp mouthpiece, or just open the lid for ActiveOn).
Sip slowly—don’t gulp! The scent travels to your nose and gives you that taste by scent experience.
Keep your bottle upright and clean for the freshest flavour.
If you hear bubbles while sipping, you’re doing it right! Bubbles = scent = taste.
Switch up your pods for new adventures, and check if your pod still smells strong (if not, time for a new one).
